name: clawpod-cloud-webhooks
title: ClawPod Cloud Webhooks
description: Use to onboard, inspect, audit, preview, change, or verify ClawPod Cloud webhook sources, playbooks, rules, and events; it does not host arbitrary webhooks, while Quick Tunnel can separately expose a temporary local preview.

auth.onboard.description: Perform approval-gated protected onboarding, identity/tenant/permission readback, and stop before mutation.

audit.config.description: Audit known broken and unsafe configuration.

source.test-local.description: Locally validate body cap and construct, but never emit, HMAC signature.

secret.rotate-warning.description: Warn and verify previous credential overlap metadata.

secret.regenerate-warning.description: Warn that older rotation overlap may remain valid.

source.get.description: Get one redacted Source by exact ID.

source.create.description: Create and GET-verify a typed Source after exact preview confirmation.

source.update.description: Read, full-object update, and GET-verify a typed Source.

source.delete.description: Delete an exact Source and verify absence from the authoritative list.

source.enable.description: Enable a Source through full-object update and GET readback.

source.disable.description: Disable a Source through full-object update and GET readback.

playbook.get.description: Get one redacted Playbook by exact ID.

playbook.create.description: Create and GET-verify a typed Playbook after exact preview confirmation.

playbook.update.description: Read, full-object update, and GET-verify a typed Playbook.

playbook.delete.description: Delete an exact Playbook and verify absence from the authoritative list.

rule.get.description: Get one redacted Rule by exact ID.

rule.create.description: Create and GET-verify a typed Rule after exact preview confirmation.

rule.update.description: Read, full-object update, and GET-verify a typed Rule.

rule.delete.description: Delete an exact Rule and verify absence from the authoritative list.

rule.enable.description: Enable a Rule through full-object update and GET readback.

rule.disable.description: Disable a Rule through full-object update and GET readback.

event.get.description: Get one redacted Event by exact ID.

rule.reorder.description: Change Rule priority through full-object update and verify readback.

source.rotate-secret.description: Execute evidenced Source rotate-secret action, redact returned secret, and verify overlap metadata.

source.regenerate.description: Execute evidenced Source regenerate action, redact returned secret, and verify overlap metadata.

event.inspect-redacted.description: Inspect Event without sensitive headers or tokens.

event.verify.description: Verify terminal status, empty error, and optional destination evidence.

mutation.preview.description: Produce a redacted create/update/delete/action preview and effect digest.

lifecycle.execute.description: Execute at most 30 allowlisted lifecycle steps with one login and one process-memory CookieJar; each mutation retains per-step approval, idempotency, and effect-digest checks.
